mapper.sql: o.id, o.opportunity_no, o.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.clue_id, o.owner_id, u.name AS owner_name, o.product_id, p.name AS product_name, o.source_type, o.stage, o.requirement, o.expected_amount, o.expected_close_date, o.next_action_time, o.lost_reason, o.lost_competitor, o.result_remark, o.order_tran_id, o.version, o.create_time, o.create_by, o.update_time, o.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_opportunity o LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON o.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_opportunity o LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON o.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_opportunity SET stage = #{targetStage}, lost_reason = CASE WHEN #{targetStage} IN ('LOST', 'SHELVED', 'CLOSED') THEN #{reason} ELSE lost_reason END, lost_competitor = CASE WHEN #{targetStage} = 'LOST' THEN #{competitor} ELSE lost_competitor END, result_remark = CASE WHEN #{targetStage} IN ('WON', 'LOST', 'SHELVED', 'CLOSED') THEN #{remark} ELSE result_remark END, next_action_time = #{nextActionTime}, order_tran_id = CASE WHEN #{targetStage} = 'WON' THEN #{orderTranId} ELSE order_tran_id END, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stage = #{expectedStage}
